subject: ggplot2 feature request inf point in bounds

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: ggplot2 feature request inf point in bounds
parts:
Hi,

Currently -Inf and Inf allow points to be specified at boundaries of
plot. When geom_point is used at plot boundaries, half of the point
is cpliiped by the plot. I'd like to see the whole point.

Either the boundaries should be expandable by a pointsize, or I
should be able to disable clipping for a plot to see the whole point.

-Alex

messages.author: a3c668b849637905
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 feature request inf point in bounds
parts:
You can disable clipping by post-processing the ggplot object before drawing,

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/9690648/point-clipped-on-x-axis-in-ggplot/9691256#9691256

but some control over clipping during the plot creation might be
desirable (in opts() maybe?).


b.
